Path 1, deliveryGOALS §1.3

Argo CD source hydrator

Commit the rendered YAML back to Git, so what's in Git is what runs.

WHAT IT IS

Argo CD renders Helm or Kustomize and commits the output to a hydrated branch. Reviews read real manifests instead of a chart plus values someone renders in their head.

WHAT SETS IT APART

Readable diffs are what make PR-based promotion work, and GitOps Promoter is designed around them. Kargo works mostly on dry manifests, so the hydrator matters more if we pick Promoter.

WHERE WE STAND

Trial it as part of the Promoter spike, not as a separate project.

Argo CD 3.x release line; ArgoCon, KubeCon NA 2026

TRIAL

Argo CD source hydrator: Commit the rendered YAML back to Git, so what's in Git is what runs. Where we stand: Trial it as part of the Promoter spike, not as a separate project. This is the quiet prerequisite for the promotion decision. Spike them together.
